title: Representative-normalized operation and independent-slot shifts
statement: For the actual strict-system and integral interpretations of [def-sf-integral-system-expression-domain], the reconstruction calculus of [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison], and the independently labelled input occurrences and explicit single-slot contexts of [def-pur-integral-expression-occurrences], define the canonical slotwise shift comparisons as follows. The shift structures are those of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. On strict-system tensor, its left and right comparisons are natural isomorphisms taking the shifted indicated operand to a shift of the tensor. On every K-flat pair of representatives their cochain comparison is the reindexing of total tensor generators, with coefficient 1 in the first slot and $(-1)^{ri}$ in the second slot on first degree $i$. The equality with the derived comparison uses the recorded K-flat tensor model isomorphisms. The completed first-slot tensor comparison has the same unsigned finite-level formula on every good flat-term K-flat pair and the fixed product and cone formula with diagonal coefficients $(1,(-1)^r)$, followed by shift $-1$. The completed right comparison is exactly the normalized property of [lem-sf-completed-tensor-shift-right]. These four representative characterizations are attainable and determine their data uniquely; define TensorShifts and select its uniquely determined data. Exact system pullback and open extension use their localized cochain shifts; system proper image uses the adjunction mate. Total limit uses its exact-restriction/right-derived shift, and reduction uses the mate through the actual reconstruction adjunction. Completed integral pullback uses the representative-normalized shift of [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data]; integral proper image and open extension use right derivation and exact localization. Compact support uses the actual open/proper composite. Assemble these comparisons recursively through the explicit designated-slot context, retaining its tensor side. Replacement of the input is the dependent update; the input shift is an endofunctor of the whole input-family category. The resulting source and integral expression comparisons are natural isomorphisms in every input. Finally, with every normalized Roos bridge of [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models], the total-limit shift has exactly the termwise product and shifted-cone formula on every actual strict system complex and every termwise shifted representative. Thus it applies in particular to the strict tower underlying $S_pJ_j\mathcal R(K)$, with no replacement of that tower.
